# MyScoutee

122 tracked tasks; 122 measured. **40,770,858,128 tokens**, **1,056.403 allocated h**, **$32,180.82 known-rate API equivalent subtotal**. MSC-117, MSC-122, MSC-123 and MSC-124 have unpriced model usage; full cost is unavailable. Task attribution is estimated; activity includes tool waits, and costs are not invoices.

[MSC-118](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap/issues/156): **182,287,382 tokens** through **2026-10-16T14:49:00Z**, including implementation, QA and corrections. Scoped guide QA is **PASS / CLOSED**; template regression closed separately under MSC-122 on October 17.

[MSC-117](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap/issues/155) is **Done** for its accepted development scope, with explicit evidence limits and separate template/live qualification.

[MSC-116](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap/issues/154) is **Done** for the consolidated development QA scope, including the remaining MSC-119 guide introduction. Exact effort and verification boundaries are recorded on the task and in the measurement ledger.

[MSC-122](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap/issues/160) is **Done**: reusable components and MyScoutee Template v1.4.0, published packages, documentation and verified VMware installation. MSC-120/121 retain their completed measurement boundaries.

[Measurement ledger](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap/tree/master/guides/project-history/myscoutee) · [Account heatmap](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap#measured-token-activity). Task and account totals overlap; never add them together.

Latest account `r` report: **42,842,296,756 tokens**; combined retained daily records: **45,088,868,957** through **October 16**, refreshed October 17. Account lifetime active hours are not supplied by the usage API; task timing is recorded above. Account and project values overlap and are not additive totals.

## MSC-123 deployment/release update

[MSC-123](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap/issues/161): **Done**. MSC-123 complete: VMware/device scope closed; app/template signed 1.4.1 and Components registry published. Production Netcup upgraded from package 1.3.0 / frontend 1.3.3 to exact signed 1.4.1; host qualification, 13 public checks, Angular render and retained-data checks PASS. 347,361,510 tokens / 5.688961 allocated h through 2026-10-17T14:40:04.051000+00:00; shared allocation counted once. Full API cost unavailable. Both app/template releases and canonical discovery are verified. The template exact-DEB VMware smoke and Components registry publication are complete.


## MSC-124 release 1.4.2

[MSC-124](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap/issues/162): **Done**. MSC-124 complete: EN/HU/DE/ES application/admin/backend catalogs, nonblocking setup and Firebase/avatar fixes; VMware handoff and owner mobile checks accepted. Separate v1.4.2 tags/releases and two GHCR images published. Netcup partial update: 9 healthy containers, only API/nginx changed, 13/13 public HTTPS checks, four-language parity and retained users/configuration/947 media objects PASS. Installed DEB stays 1.4.1. 57,483,958 tokens / 1.864686 allocated h through 2026-10-19T22:28:52.036Z; includes the owner-assigned October 18 roadmap commit. Full API valuation unavailable.

The October 18 account-heatmap commit is retained under this task; its account readings remain historical and are not increased by task usage. Final accounting writes after the measurement cutoff are excluded.

items.title: MSC-117: Add direct WebRTC group calls with own STUN and MLS
items.body:
Chat phone actions start direct group audio calls using the owned STUN service and existing chat WebSocket. Media travels between browsers. Optional camera and participant controls reuse the shared popup/menu/SmartList implementation.

## Scope and acceptance
- Own Docker coturn STUN-only service in dev, prod and disposable E2E Compose; no TURN, SFU or external STUN provider.
- Authenticated chat WebSocket for ephemeral signaling and live STUN health. Green enabled phone when available; mirrored red crossed disabled handset when unavailable.
- Phone before participant avatars in the second header row. Lazy app-popup joins with microphone muted and camera off, matches the chat geometry and permits camera inside the call.
- Actual participant tiles in the existing horizontal SmartList native stepper: mobile 2×2, laptop up to 3×2 based on available space, further participants on subsequent pages. Full-width projected grid; fullscreen/restore remains high contrast.
- Only visible peer video is requested. Fully offscreen peers pause their camera sender with encrypted receive control and replaceTrack(null); partially visible pages can overlap during swipe. Audio remains independent and continuous through paging, focus and resize.
- Individual receive-video, playback-volume and level-preserving mute controls in the compact upward app-popup. Panel and tile corner controls share state and handlers; Me camera matches the bottom camera button. No All videos button or global receive state.
- Header uses the standard app-menu icon/label/switch Follow speakers control. When enabled, current and recent speakers lead the visible page; recent order survives speech gaps. Standard filled active blue palette; no waiting badge or verification-code button.
- Real local 48-band, 40 px FFT spectrum and speaker outline. Muted frames/microphones are red, speaking microphones green, camera-off marker red below microphone. Shared microphone noise/gain processing.
- Server-authorized admin/resource-manager mute; release requires the participant to enable their own microphone.
- MLS RFC 9420 signaling through Wire CoreCrypto, call-scoped in-memory keys, epoch rotation and oldest surviving coordinator failover. Native direct WebRTC DTLS-SRTP media protection.
- Workspace chat categories follow the existing enabled-feature rules. English/Hungarian labels use the canonical i18n catalogs.

- The Tasks button in a case chat opens only its task board through the existing reference flow. It does not mount the case list or prefetch its scheduled-task counters; normal case-list and notification navigation retain their current behavior.
